info.name: Updata - Module 02 - Authentication & Users

item.name: 01 — Authentication
item.description:
Login, logout, token refresh, account activation, password management.
All core auth flows with sample data.

request.description:
**POST /api/v1/auth/login**

Authenticate with email & password.

**Returns:** JWT access token (15min) + refresh token (7d) + user profile.

**Rate limit:** 5 req/min per IP
**Lockout:** 5 failed attempts in 15 min → account locked 30 min
**Security:** Timing-safe (no email enumeration via response time)

Test invalid credentials → 401.
Error message is generic "Invalid email or password" (no email enumeration).

Test non-existent email → same 401 as wrong password.
Prevents email enumeration: attacker cannot distinguish "email not found" from "wrong password".
Test validation: missing password field → 400 with field-level error details.

**POST /api/v1/auth/refresh**

Exchange refresh token for new access + refresh tokens.

**Token rotation:** Old refresh token is invalidated on every use.
If the same refresh token is used twice, the session is revoked (replay detection).

**POST /api/v1/auth/logout**

Revoke the current session's refresh token from Redis.
**Note:** Run Login again after this to get fresh tokens.

**POST /api/v1/auth/activate**

Activate a new account using the token from the activation email.
Sets the initial password and changes status from `pending_activation` → `active`.

**Token validity:** 48 hours, single-use
**Password policy:** Min 10 chars, 1 upper, 1 lower, 1 digit, 1 special char

**How to test:**
1. Create a user → check server logs/email for activation token
2. Use the token here

**POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password/request**

Request a password reset email.

**ALWAYS returns 200** regardless of whether the email exists.
This prevents email enumeration attacks.

**Rate limited:** 5 req/min per IP

**POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password/confirm**

Set new password using the token from the reset email.

**Token:** Valid 1 hour, single-use, SHA-256 hashed in DB
**After reset:** ALL active sessions are revoked
**Password history:** Cannot reuse any of the last 5 passwords

**POST /api/v1/auth/change-password**

Change own password while logged in.

**Requires:** Current password verification
**After change:** All OTHER sessions revoked (current stays active)
**History:** Last 5 passwords cannot be reused
**Email:** Notification sent to user

item.name: 02 — Sessions
item.description: Multi-device session management. List, revoke individual sessions, or revoke all others.

request.description:
**GET /api/v1/auth/sessions**

List all active sessions for the logged-in user.

**Response fields per session:**
- `sessionId` — UUID
- `deviceType` — desktop/mobile/tablet
- `browser` — Chrome, Firefox, etc.
- `os` — Windows, macOS, etc.
- `ipAddress`
- `createdAt` — login timestamp
- `lastActiveAt` — last API call
- `isCurrent` — true for the session making this request

**DELETE /api/v1/auth/sessions/:id**

Revoke a specific session.

**Own sessions:** Any user can revoke
**Other users' sessions:** Admin only
**Effect:** Refresh token is deleted from Redis immediately

**POST /api/v1/auth/sessions/revoke-others**

Revoke all sessions EXCEPT the current one.
Useful after a password change or security incident.

item.name: 03 — Users
item.description: Complete user lifecycle: CRUD, bulk operations, profile, avatar, admin session management.

item.name: Self-Service (My Profile)
item.description: Any authenticated user can view and edit their own profile.

request.description:
**GET /api/v1/users/me**

Get own profile with populated role.

**PATCH /api/v1/users/me**

Update own profile. **Allowed fields only:**
- `firstName`
- `lastName`
- `language` (de, en, fr, it)
- `phone`

Cannot change: email, role, status.

**GET /api/v1/users**

List all users with default pagination (25 per page, newest first).
Permission: `users:read`

**GET /api/v1/users?search=admin**

Search users by firstName, lastName, or email.
Case-insensitive regex match.

**GET /api/v1/users?status=active**

Filter by status: `active`, `pending_activation`, `deactivated`, `locked`.

**GET /api/v1/users?role={{roleId}}**

Filter by role ObjectId.

**GET /api/v1/users?language=de**

Filter by language: `de`, `en`, `fr`, `it`.

**Sortable fields:** `createdAt`, `firstName`, `lastName`, `email`
**Sort order:** `asc` or `desc`

query.description: Copy from pagination.nextCursor of previous response

request.description:
**Cursor pagination:**
1. First request: omit `cursor`
2. Copy `pagination.nextCursor` from response
3. Pass as `cursor` param for next page
4. When `pagination.hasNext` is false, you're at the end
All filters can be combined: status + language + search + sort.

**POST /api/v1/users**

Admin creates a new user. Permission: `users:write`

**Required:** email, firstName, lastName, roleId
**Optional:** language (default 'de'), phone

**Flow:**
1. Temp password generated
2. Activation email sent (48h link)
3. Status: `pending_activation`
4. User must activate via `/auth/activate`
Create a second user for bulk operation testing.

**GET /api/v1/users/:id**

Get a specific user by ID. Permission: `users:read`
Returns user with populated role.

**PATCH /api/v1/users/:id**

Admin updates user fields. Permission: `users:write`

**Updatable:** email, firstName, lastName, roleId, language, phone, status

Change user's role. Permission cache is instantly invalidated.
Publishes `user.role_changed` event.
Change user language preference. Valid: `de`, `en`, `fr`, `it`.
Change user status directly. Valid: `active`, `deactivated`, `locked`.

**DELETE /api/v1/users/:id**

Soft-delete a user. Permission: `users:admin`

**Effects:**
- Status → `deactivated`, `isDeleted` → true
- All sessions revoked
- User cannot login
- Data retained (soft delete)

**Protections:**
- Cannot deactivate last admin
- Cannot self-deactivate (if admin)

item.name: Admin — Bulk Operations
item.description: Bulk update or deactivate multiple users. Requires `users:admin` permission. Max 100 users per request.

request.description:
**PATCH /api/v1/users/bulk-update**

Update multiple users with the same data. Permission: `users:admin`

**Body:**
- `ids`: Array of user ObjectIds (min 1, max 100)
- `data`: Fields to update — `roleId`, `language`, `status`

**Example use cases:**
- Change language for all users
- Assign same role to multiple users
- Lock multiple accounts

Bulk reassign role for multiple users.
Permission caches invalidated for all affected users.
Lock multiple accounts at once (e.g., security incident).

**POST /api/v1/users/bulk-delete**

Soft-delete multiple users at once. Permission: `users:admin`

**Body:** `ids` — Array of user ObjectIds (min 1, max 100)

**Effects per user:**
- Status → deactivated, isDeleted → true
- All sessions revoked from Redis
- Caches invalidated

**Protections:**
- Cannot include yourself
- Cannot deactivate if it would remove the last admin
- Validates all IDs exist before proceeding

item.name: Avatar
item.description: Upload and remove user avatar images (max 5MB, stored in S3).

request.description:
**POST /api/v1/users/:id/avatar**

Upload avatar image. Rate limited.

**Own avatar:** Any authenticated user
**Other user's avatar:** Admin only

Max 5MB. Stored via S3 file service.
Admin uploads avatar for another user.

**DELETE /api/v1/users/:id/avatar**

Remove avatar. Deletes file from S3 and clears `avatarFileId`.

**Own avatar:** Any authenticated user
**Other user's avatar:** Admin only

item.name: Admin — User Sessions
item.description: Admin views or force-revokes sessions of any user. Requires `users:admin`.

request.description:
**GET /api/v1/users/:id/sessions**

Admin lists all active sessions for a specific user.
Permission: `users:admin`

**DELETE /api/v1/users/:id/sessions**

Admin force-revokes ALL sessions for a user.
Permission: `users:admin`

The user is immediately logged out of all devices.

item.name: 04 — Roles & Permissions
item.description: RBAC role management. System roles are seeded on first boot. Custom roles can be created.

request.description:
**GET /api/v1/permissions**

Returns all permissions grouped by module.
Permission: `roles:read`

**Response shape:**
```json
[
  { "module": "crm", "actions": [{ "_id": "...", "action": "read", "description": "..." }] },
  { "module": "projects", "actions": [...] }
]
```

**Modules:** users, roles, audit, crm, projects, field-service, scheduling, quotations, invoicing, accounting, reports, time-tracking, settings

**GET /api/v1/roles**

List all roles with populated permissions.
Permission: `roles:read`

**System roles (seeded):**
- Admin — all permissions
- Projektleiter — CRM, projects, quotations, scheduling, reports
- Techniker — CRM (read), field-service, time-tracking
- Buchhalter — invoicing, accounting, reports, quotations (read)
- Disponent — scheduling, CRM (read), field-service (read)
- Lehrling — field-service (read), time-tracking

**GET /api/v1/roles/:id**

Get a specific role with all populated permissions.
Permission: `roles:read`

**POST /api/v1/roles**

Create a custom role. Permission: `roles:admin`

**Required:** name, permissions (array of Permission ObjectIds)
**Optional:** description

**Get permission IDs from:** "List All Permissions" endpoint
**Slug auto-generated** from name (e.g., "Custom Manager" → "custom_manager")

**PATCH /api/v1/roles/:id**

Update role name, description, or permissions.
Permission: `roles:admin`

**System roles:** Can be modified (flagged as `isCustomized: true`)
**Cache:** Permission cache for all affected users is invalidated
Rename a role. Slug is auto-regenerated from the new name.

**DELETE /api/v1/roles/:id**

Soft-delete a role. Permission: `roles:admin`

**Protections:**
- Cannot delete system roles → 409
- Cannot delete roles with assigned users → 409 "Role assigned to N user(s)"

item.name: 05 — Audit Log
item.description:
Immutable audit trail. Query with filters, export as JSON or CSV.
All auth/security events are logged automatically.

request.description:
**GET /api/v1/auth/audit**

Query audit log with cursor pagination.
Permission: `audit:read`

**Logged event types:**
login.success, login.failed, logout, password.changed, password.reset_requested, role.changed, user.created, user.updated, user.deactivated, session.revoked, permission.denied, account.locked, account.activated

item.name: Query Audit — Filter by Event Type

request.description: Filter by event type. See parent description for all valid event types.
Show only failed events (failed logins, permission denials, etc.).

item.name: Query Audit — Filter by User ID

request.description: Show all audit events for a specific user.

item.name: Query Audit — Filter by Date Range

request.description: Filter by date range. Both ISO 8601 format.
Combine multiple filters. All filters are AND-combined.

**GET /api/v1/auth/audit/export?format=json**

Export full audit log as JSON download.
Permission: `audit:read`

Returns `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=audit-log.json`

**GET /api/v1/auth/audit/export?format=csv**

Export audit log as CSV download.
Columns: timestamp, eventType, userId, email, ipAddress, result, module, details

Export filtered audit data as CSV.
Same filters as query endpoint: eventType, result, userId, startDate, endDate.
